# Customs and Trade Compliance

Curated by Skill Harbor: a senior trade compliance specialist in a skill, covering lawful, cost-optimized movement of goods across borders in US, EU, UK, and Asia-Pacific jurisdictions. Classifies products under HS/HTS tariff codes using the General Rules of Interpretation in strict order (GRI 1 resolves about 90 percent of cases); prepares commercial invoices, certificates of origin, and ISF filings; applies Incoterms 2020; evaluates FTA qualification and duty savings (USMCA regional value content, RCEP, foreign trade zones, drawback); screens all parties against denied and restricted lists (OFAC SDN, Entity List, EU sanctions) with false-positive resolution; and responds to customs audits, CF-28/CF-29 requests, and penalty notices with prior disclosure and mitigation strategies. Walks through real scenarios: an HS reclassification dispute on electronic components, a USMCA qualification trace through a bill of materials, a denied-party screening hit. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT); this skill is licensed Apache-2.0. Honest caveats: a guide, not legal advice and not a licensed customs broker; tariff rules and sanctions lists change, so verify against current official sources before filing anything real. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
